packageRules.description: Prefer release-based updates for GitHub Actions; skip digest-only PRs for actions whose pinned tag commit moved without a new release.

customManagers.description: Track engines.vscode as the @types/vscode dependency (grouped with it via the "vscode" packageRule above) so they update in the same PR. @types/vscode itself stays on the native npm manager so Renovate still regenerates package-lock.json.
